basic_info.description: 3 Story Family Home With Striking Views   4 Bedrooms, 4 Baths , 1 Car Parking in the heart of Glen Park...Private Residence w/ a light stroll to Glen Park Village shopping, restaurants and Glen Canyon Outdoor Space. Versatile floor plan showcasing an open concept main level : updated kitchen , living room, dining room, and extra den.  Below are 3 perfect family sized bedrooms on one level, a full bath and a laundry room. Above and on the entire top floor is an amazing flex space - used by the current owners as a family room with walk out pano view deck, southern light and full bath - note this space is staged as a bedroom. On the 4th level of this unique hillside property is a separate bedroom and bath - perfect for home office, guests or home gym. 39 Arbor is a great home for everyday living and entertaining. Its proximity to the Village + serene surroundings and environment make it an ideal urban oasis! One Car Garage Parking too!
